intro.text: A member of House Venture, part of Elendel's nobility, and a loose friend of Wax's who cannot hold his drink.

items.text: Worried that something would go wrong at the wedding, Steris wanted to arrange a small, manageable problem instead. Wax proposed inviting Venture, who could be counted on to make a drunken scene at the after-party, and Steris agreed and sent him an invitation.
